run_turk_pipeline: run the full MTurk annotation pipeline with tools A through D and final postprocessing
run_tool_A_preprocessing: run tool A to preprocess CSV input and prepare data for MTurk HIT creation
run_tool_B_hit_creation: run tool B to create separate MTurk HIT jobs from input commands
run_tool_C_result_collection: run tool C to fetch and collect completed HIT results from MTurk
run_tool_D_collation: run tool D to collate MTurk outputs and input job specs into combined datasets
